from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img46 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0046.png"))

# Plant 2 is right in front!
# Let us check the top rim of the pot

# Stem of plant 2:
stem = np.argwhere((img46[:,:,1] > 80) & (img46[:,:,1] < 130) & (img46[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 400))
print("Stem center x:", stem[:,1].mean())
'
